editorialPolicy.sourceGranularity: Every lexical form and every grammatical variant must cite one or more exact supporting source records.
editorialPolicy.publishRule: Only approved entries may be presented as verified. A script-digit source does not count as a lexical number-word source.
editorialPolicy.transliteration: Store transliteration separately from native-script text; never substitute transliteration for a native-script form.
editorialPolicy.ordinalPolicy: Research ordinal forms independently from cardinal forms; capture gender, number, case or classifier/context distinctions when the language requires them.
editorialPolicy.scriptPolicy: Native numeral glyphs are separate from number words. Some languages have multiple conventional numeral systems or use international digits in everyday contexts; record locale and usage notes.
